hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -E '\.py$' && uv run ruff check --fix $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS && uv run ruff format $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS || true
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -E '\.py$' && uv run mypy $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS || true
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.env' && echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit .env files' && exit 1 || exit 0
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE 'uv\.lock' && echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit lock files' && exit 1 || exit 0
